## ⏰ SALES MEETING REMINDER AUTOMATOR
**What it does:** Polls Pipedrive every 15 minutes for meetings due in 55–65 minutes → dedupes against a Google Sheets log so nobody gets reminded twice → AI writes a short personalized SMS + email naming the meeting time and one real context detail → sends both (each branch continues on error) → logs the result and sends you a Telegram summary.

**You'll need:**
- Pipedrive account + API token (pipedrive.com → Settings → Personal preferences → API)
- Google Sheets OAuth2 credential + a spreadsheet with a `ReminderLog` tab
- OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com)
- Gmail OAuth2 credential
- SMS provider with an HTTP API (CloudTalk, Twilio, or similar) + a sender number
- Telegram bot token + your chat ID (@BotFather → /newbot)

**Status flow in Sheets:** `NEW` → `PROCESSING` → `REMINDER_SENT` / `FAILED`
**Key pitfalls handled:** schedule polling instead of a Wait node · timezone alignment via `instance_timezone` in CONFIG — Reminder Settings · send-once guard by `activity_id` · internal attendees excluded by domain · SMS/email branches continue on error · phone numbers normalized to E.164.

## STEP 1 — Poll the CRM for meetings due in ~1 hour
`Every 15 Minutes Trigger` → `CONFIG — Reminder Settings` → `Fetch Meetings — Pipedrive Activities` (GET activities, type=meeting, done=0) → `Normalize Meetings — Window + Timezone` keeps only meetings due in the 55–65 minute window, converts times to `instance_timezone`, drops internal attendees, and normalizes phone numbers to E.164.

## STEP 2 — Send-once guard + log to Google Sheets
`Read Reminder Log` → `Dedupe — Send-Once Guard` skips any `activity_id` already marked `REMINDER_SENT` → `Log Reminder — Status NEW` appends/updates the row → `Update Sheet — Status PROCESSING`.

## STEP 3 — AI writes the reminder
`AI Agent — Write Reminder` (gpt-4o-mini via `OpenAI Chat Model — Reminder`) with `Structured Output Parser — Reminder Copy` outputs sms_text, email_subject, email_body, and personalization_notes. The prompt forbids invented facts — it may only use the CRM fields passed in.

## STEP 4 — Send SMS + email (independent branches)
`Send SMS — Provider API` and `Gmail — Send Reminder Email` run in parallel, both set to continue on error so a failed text never swallows the email. `Mark SMS Result` / `Mark Email Result` tag each outcome, `Merge — Combine Channel Results` joins them, and `Evaluate Send Results` sets the final status.

## STEP 5 — Final status + Telegram summary
`Update Sheet — Final Status` writes `REMINDER_SENT` (at least one channel succeeded) or `FAILED`, plus per-channel results and `sent_at`. `Build Run Summary` → `Telegram — Send Run Summary` reports how many reminders went out this run.

options.systemMessage: =You write short, specific sales-meeting reminders. Use ONLY the facts given in the user message — never invent a company, role, topic, link, or detail that is not provided. The SMS must be under 320 characters, name the meeting time, and mention exactly one concrete context detail (the company, person, or topic) when one is provided. The email is 3-5 short sentences with the same rules. Sign off with the sender name given in the user message. Output ONLY via the structured output parser.
